description: This file contains a Java class 'GLES20TriangleRenderer' that implements an OpenGL ES 2.0 renderer for Android. It manages rendering a textured triangle with rotation, loading shaders, handling textures, and rendering the scene. It is likely part of an example or sample app demonstrating GLES20 rendering.

classes.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
classes.description: A class that implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface to render a textured rotating triangle using OpenGL ES 2.0 on Android.

methods.name: GLES20TriangleRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes buffers and stores the context.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears the screen, sets shaders, binds textures, updates rotation, and draws the triangle each frame.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix when the surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Sets up shader programs, retrieves attribute and uniform locations, creates and binds textures, and initializes view matrices.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of given type from source code.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates, attaches, and links vertex and fragment shaders into an OpenGL program.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws exceptions if any occur.
